description: Contrato de cada fila de sources/DERIVATION_LEDGER.csv. El esquema valida la forma de una fila; scripts/validate_derivation_ledger.py aplica además el dialecto CSV, las referencias, los estados, la cobertura y los invariantes entre filas y archivos.
title: IFATIGUE-INFRA6-M6 derivation ledger row contract
x-cross-row-invariants: row_id is unique and begins with ROW- plus derivation_id plus a support-edge suffix
all rows sharing derivation_id are identical except row_id and the support-edge columns support_ref_type, support_ref_id, support_locator_or_decision, source_verification_status and support_level
parent_derivation_id resolves, contains no self-reference and the derivation graph is acyclic
every evidence support resolves to SOURCES.evidence_units and preserves its verification_status
every decision support and approval_refs item matches T00-T17, resolves and is approved unless materialization_status is blocked
target_value parses as duplicate-key-free canonical JSON and contains no non-finite number
multi-value references contain no duplicate and controlled numeric references are in ascending order
every internal path declared in PROVENANCE.planned_tree and planned_file_sets has at least one derivation and no ledger target uses external dist paths
file_origin_class equals the origin_class declared for its destination
materialized_t03 and verified_t04 require an existing destination and materialization_refs; blocked outputs keep target_value null
no active contradictory target_value exists for the same target_path and target_locator

atomic JSON Pointer rows reconstruct each scenario and oracle deterministically; each pointer has one active value, compatible prefixes only, and @materialization-recipe is metadata rather than document content
D1-D9, RL1-RL9, R1-R8, F1-F6, A1-A4 and M0-M6 are covered collectively; A5 is not claimed
F6 rows use only A3 and A4 and never A5

x-exit-code-contract.1: the inputs were readable but at least one contract check failed

x-row-profiles.derived_result: results, logs, environment y matrices observadas; null hasta ejecución.
x-row-profiles.derived_trace: traces S00-S14; nunca S15 y null hasta ejecución.
x-row-profiles.doctoral_specification: spec/thesis; síntesis doctoral y separación explícita de lo publicado.
x-row-profiles.engineering_decision: spec/decisions; decisión aprobada y parámetros de realización.
x-row-profiles.exclusion_record: Contexto no ejecutable, con preserve_and_exclude y límites explícitos.
x-row-profiles.oracle: oracles/S00-S15.expected.json; esperado congelado antes de implementar.
x-row-profiles.rejection: un único registro de rechazo S15, sin traza de modulación.
x-row-profiles.scenario_input: scenarios/S00-S15; solo entradas sintéticas, nunca resultados u oráculos.
x-row-profiles.source_transcription: spec/published; solo evidencia publicada, sin decisiones doctorales ni semántica de la instancia.

x-scientific-invariants: spec/published is pure source transcription: no thesis-only perspective, canonical domain, execution policy or doctoral decision; does_not_support edges are excluded negative-audit records and never positive evidence

the influence formula records /influence/input_bindings/coping_potential as host.baseline.coping_potential, /lambda as influence.parameters.lambda, /z as factor_state.level and /result as output.coping_potential

there are exactly 16 input-only scenarios S00-S15 with a stable event and optional oracle_ref, plus 16 separately frozen oracles whose expected.output_contract has exists=true, a complete appraisal_vector and protected dimensions for S00-S14, and only exists=false for S15
there are exactly 15 derived traces S00-S14, no S15 modulation trace, and exactly one S15 rejection record
the test catalog enumerates exactly the 18 unique test_id/fq_method pairs approved by T03-QA-011 rather than recording only an expected count
GEA, the 2020 wrapper and the reported microbenchmark remain preserve-and-exclude context and never support execution, calibration, or observed results
results, traces, logs, environment, run metadata and benchmarks contain no observed value before their producing run is materialized

decision_approval_status.approved: La decisión se resolvió por el autor, por autorización permanente o en un registro previo aprobado.
decision_approval_status.not_required: El objetivo no depende de una decisión aprobatoria.
decision_approval_status.pending: La decisión todavía no autoriza materialización.
decision_approval_status.superseded: La aprobación se conserva solo como historial.

materialization_status.blocked: Existe una decisión abierta o una precondición ausente; target_value permanece null.
materialization_status.excluded: La derivación no autoriza materialización ejecutable y se conserva por trazabilidad.
materialization_status.materialized_t03: El objetivo existe como resultado de T03 y materialization_refs registra la evidencia.
materialization_status.planned: Objetivo identificado que todavía no se materializó; una salida derivada permanece null hasta su productor.
materialization_status.superseded: La derivación se conserva solo como historial y no autoriza la versión vigente.
materialization_status.verified_t04: T04 verificó el objetivo desde una reproducción limpia y materialization_refs registra la evidencia.

source_verification_status.failed: La evidencia o su localizador fallaron la verificación.
source_verification_status.not_applicable: La arista no usa una unidad de evidencia.
source_verification_status.pending: La verificación de la evidencia sigue abierta.
source_verification_status.verified: La unidad de evidencia resolvió a un estado verificado; el validador mapea los estados calificados de SOURCES.json.
